messages:
alex_chan: Heads-up — Orchid Labs procurement replied to our invoice request: they will not accept any invoice until we provide a SAP-style PO and their internal cost-center code. They say PO must match this pattern and include signed SOW reference. Can billing advise on options?

maria_g: Thanks Alex. Do we have the contract ID / SOW file on record for Orchid Labs? If yes we can attach and issue a proforma so they can start internal approvals. Otherwise we need the sales rep to confirm SOW reference. :thinking_face: 

sam_r: I handled the deal — contract id RL-2024-0487 and SOW v3 is in Zendesk ticket #4021. Procurement is insisting on an 10-digit PO that begins with the plant code (they gave example). I asked them for exact example.

orchid_procurement: OrchidProcurementBot: Required PO format: `ORC-PP-########` (e.g. ORC-PP-00012345). Also include cost center `CC-OR-9876` on the invoice and reference SOW RL-2024-0487. We cannot process invoices without those fields.

maria_g: OK got it. Two options: (A) Issue a proforma with SOW attached and note they must provide the PO for final invoicing; (B) Hold and wait for the PO, then issue final invoice. Proforma is non-taxable placeholder, but we can add a note about VAT if needed. Which does sales prefer?

kevin_ops: If they need the invoice to be entered into SAP we should match their exact PO string. Billing systems often reject invoices missing the internal CC field. If sales can get the PO before EOD we can issue the final invoice same day.

sam_r: I'll push the procurement contact again — escalated to their finance lead. If they give a PO, format will be ORC-PP-000XXXXX and include `CC-OR-9876`. I can also send the signed SOW PDF right now.

maria_g: Please drop SOW here (or attach link) and confirm billing address and VAT number for Orchid. I have a draft invoice template ready. Example invoice line we'll use: 
```
Qty 1 | Redwood Inference — Dedicated Capacity (monthly) | USD 9,500.00
```
Add: SOW ref RL-2024-0487, PO: <placeholder>, Cost center: <placeholder>.

sam_r: Uploaded SOW v3: https://files.redwood/invoices/RL-2024-0487-sow.pdf — VAT: GB123456789, Billing addr: Orchid Labs Ltd, 42 Greenway, London. I told them we can issue a proforma now.

maria_g: Drafted proforma and posted to the ticket. Proforma number PR-2129876. Sent to orchid-procurement@orchid.com with note: "Please supply official PO in ORC-PP format and cost center for final invoicing".

orchid_procurement: OrchidProcurementBot: We verified receipt of proforma. We will provide official PO after internal approvals. Expected turnaround 2 business days.

kevin_ops: For tracking — I'll tag the case in our invoice hold tracker and mark as awaiting external PO. If PO doesn't arrive in 3 days, we follow up via AM.

maria_g: Great. If they send PO, forward it here and we'll swap proforma for final invoice and mark as billable. If card charge was attempted earlier, we should cancel and re-run once PO is provided.

sam_r: FYI — procurement called: they can fast-track, PO likely ORC-PP-00012901. I'll post when I have confirmation. :thumbsup:

alex_chan: Thanks everyone. Keep notes in the ticket. Marking this thread resolved for support until we get the PO.

maria_g: Update: Received PO ORC-PP-00012901 and cost center CC-OR-9876 at 2129876777. Final invoice issued and emailed. Closing out. :white_check_mark:
